newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany suspends aid to Cambodia, slams "putsch".
newsitem.headline: Germany suspends aid to Cambodia, slams "putsch".

text.p: Germany on Thursday said it was suspending development aid to Cambodia with immediate effect and condemned the overthrow of Prince Norodom Ranariddh by rival co-premier Hun Sen last weekend.
"The putsch contradicts all democratic and legal principles and the Cambodian constitution of 1992," Development Minister Carl-Dieter Spranger said in a statement.
"The violence endangers German development workers. Therefore development aid will be suspended."
Spranger's ministry said the German government would agree on any further actions concerning Cambodia within the European Union and the international aid community.
Germany restarted aid to Cambodia in 1992 and has given 119 million marks since then, donating 17.6 million marks in 1996, the ministry said.
